casual-games.label: Casual Games
casual-games.recommendation: Start broad, then shift spend toward creatives and placements showing the strongest D1 payer signals.

midcore-games.label: Midcore Games
midcore-games.recommendation: Use early revenue signals and a diversified creative set to give value-based optimization enough room to learn.

finance.label: Finance
finance.recommendation: Define a high-intent post-install event early; funded account or first deposit usually gives a clearer quality signal.

shopping.label: Shopping & Rewards
shopping.recommendation: Pair purchase-event optimization with seasonal creative testing to unlock more efficient scale.

sports.label: Sports & Betting
sports.recommendation: Plan spend around high-interest events and optimize toward first deposit rather than registration alone.

utility.label: Utility & Lifestyle
utility.recommendation: Use activation or trial-start signals to separate engaged users from low-intent installs as quickly as possible.
